label: Perfect love in the hiddenness challenge: Sig.PerfectLove w means a perfectly loving God exists at w
term: perfect love in the hiddenness challenge
definition: Sig.PerfectLove w means a perfectly loving God exists at w. Love seeks the good and personal relationship of capable creatures; whether that entails immediate conscious access at every capable time is not part of the predicate definition. GodLoves, AlwaysOpen and QualifiedOpen are distinct open normative readings.
note: Explicit interpretation vocabulary for #252. Source claims retain their own pinned locators; these records do not add axioms or establish the truth of the interpreted predicates.

formal_gap.meaning: Sig.PerfectLove w says that a perfectly loving God exists at world w: love that seeks the good and the personal relationship of capable creatures. It is a predicate on the worlds of the hiddenness signature (#252), supplied by each interpretation.
formal_gap.examples_unavailable: Whether a perfectly loving God exists at the actual world is what the hiddenness argument disputes; an example would presuppose an answer.
exclusions: Immediate conscious access at every capable time: whether love entails it is not part of the predicate (DISAMB-HIDDENNESS-LOVE-ACCESS).
Sig.God alone: GodLoves links the two as an open premise.
open_obligations: GodLoves, AlwaysOpen and QualifiedOpen are distinct open normative readings that use it.
